fields.Name: GPT-6 Luna Decisions
fields.Description: OpenAI's decision model: gpt-6-luna served by OpenAI's Decisions API (POST /v1/decisions), announced at DevDay on September 29, 2026 and in public beta. It answers Likelihood, Choice and Score questions about text or image input, in one call, with a probability for every allowed option, and writes no text. OpenAI may decline any question; MJ then fails the attempt and fails over. OpenAI reports a latency of about 150 ms and charges $0.10 per million input tokens, with no output or cache charge. OpenAI does not yet document per-request limits (questions, options or context). MJ reaches it directly through the OpenAIDecision driver, or through OpenRouter's Decisions API as openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions (pinned to the dated openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions-20261006, served by OpenAI with a 1,050,000-token context) through the OpenRouterDecision driver. MJ sends the state as text; image input is not used yet. Its raw probabilities are not calibrated to MJ's data, so set thresholds on calibrated values. This is a Decision model, separate from the GPT-6 Luna LLM.
